name: Martial Arts
description: While unarmed or wielding only Monk weapons (Simple Melee weapons and Light Martial Melee weapons) and wearing no armor or Shield: you can roll 1d6 in place of the normal damage of your Unarmed Strike or Monk weapons, you can use Dexterity instead of Strength for their attack and damage rolls (and for Grapple/Shove save DCs), and you can make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.

name: Unarmored Defense
description: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Wisdom modifiers.

name: Flurry of Blows
description: Expend 1 Focus Point to make two Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action.

name: Patient Defense
description: Take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action. Alternatively, expend 1 Focus Point to take both Disengage and Dodge as a Bonus Action.

name: Step of the Wind
description: Take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. Alternatively, expend 1 Focus Point to take both Disengage and Dash as a Bonus Action and double your jump distance for the turn.

name: Unarmored Movement
description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you are not wearing armor or wielding a Shield.

name: Deflect Attacks
description: When an attack hits you with Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, use your Reaction to reduce its total damage by 1d10 + Dexterity modifier + Monk level. If reduced to 0, spend 1 Focus Point to redirect it: a visible target within 5 feet (melee) or 60 feet without Total Cover (ranged) makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d6 + Dexterity modifier damage of the same type.

name: Open Hand Technique
source: Warrior of the Open Hand Level 3
description: When Flurry of Blows hits, choose one effect: Addle prevents Opportunity Attacks until the start of the target's next turn; Push moves it up to 15 feet on a failed Strength save; Topple knocks it Prone on a failed Dexterity save. Save DC = 8 + Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus.
